lines.en: Niki’s first night back was pretty peaceful, all things considered.
At least if you can ignore the part where I was made to sleep on the floor while she got the bed.
That’s just one of many compromises that will have to be made if things are going to get better, though. And I’m more than willing to make many more so long as it keeps her by my side.

I’m out and about now, trying to reintroduce myself to society as a slightly less depressed man with a slightly angrier daughter who will need to suffer slightly more if she ever wants to become slightly human.
And while this makes things inarguably more dangerous for all of us, it’s something I’m making a bet on because drastic times call for drastic measures.
So she can try to prop up the status quo against the cage I’ve been trapped in all she likes. The fact of the matter is I’ve begun the process of melting it down to reshape it.
And if that reforms the world as we know it, good. In fact, if it changes anything at all, good. Witness this effort of mine, for it will be the first and last you ever see.
And take note of all that rides in with it, for these will be the impurities that carry me from here to Heaven.
Assuming, of course, that I am not assassinated by some sort of angry fan before any of that happens since Niki decided to turn me into the most hated man in Kumon-mi in just twenty-four hours.
I’ve got to hand it to her, though. I am finally getting the disdain I deserve. So for that and so much more, I thank her.
I reserve the right to stay mildly angry about the rest of the consequences, though. So please excuse me while I deal with more of them now.
: Hello?
: Papa! What have you done?!
: Overall or just this morning?
: Overall! Big sis Chika is broken again and Chinami doesn’t know how to fix her this time!
: Chinami never knows how to fix her because Chika is unfixable. But yes, I guess it makes sense that she’d be...off given recent developments.
: What developments?! Chinami still doesn’t know what happened!
: Have you not been using your phone? I’m apparently the talk of the town right now.
: If Chinami finds out that Papa is in one of those videos Tsukasa has been watching lately, she’s going to be very disappointed!
: Tell you what — are you guys both at home right now? I can come over and face Chika directly. It’s probably easier than handling all of this over the phone.
: Papa can try, but big sis Chika hasn’t said a word since yesterday. And also, she has a knife.
: Please lock yourself in the bathroom until I get there.
: Okay. But please bring Chinami food since big sis Chika normally makes breakfast for her and can’t this time because Papa is apparently famous now.
: I’ll take you both out to eat once your sister is functional again. Okay?
: Okay! Bring a weapon too. Chinami thinks you might need one. Bye!
: Hah...
I try not to take too much of the blame on the way to Chika’s place. I mean, it’s not like I haven’t tried to tell her about this before.
And yes, I imagine most of that is the fruit of some sort of self-preservational tic. But this is one she was born with rather than an injury received during her fall from grace.
Will my words be enough to mend her broken bones, though? Is there a song I can play from speakers meant to soothe instead of ones there to distract her while I steal her heart once more?
Find out soon in “My Adventures as a Trash Compactor,” my newly named autobiography, where I tell the uncensored story of how I turn what’s already broken into something even smaller.
Something no one would want but me.
For it’s this exact secret that allows me to live at all in the first place.
: Thank goodness Papa is finally here! Chinami doesn’t know what else she can do!
: You look familiar for some reason.
: Oh! Chinami bleached her hair again and she forgot that Papa hasn’t seen it yet. Maybe Chinami just reminds you of Chinami?
: No...I don’t think that’s it. But I also don’t think I want to know what it is, so just go ahead and brief me on the situation.
: The situation is this way! And it’s not going anywhere any time soon, so Chinami will accompany you ten feet from the doorway so you can see it yourself!
: And hopefully fix it because Chinami is hungry and fearful she may never eat again!
: You know how to make your own breakfast, Chinami. You don’t need Chika for that.
: Chinami would sooner starve than do things on her own! Come, Papa! We have to fix my sister!
: Okay, journey over. We’re here.
: Thank you for escorting me a total of three steps. I never would have made it here on my own.
: You can thank Chinami by getting to the bottom of this.
: I already know what the cause is. Her idol decided to tell the entire world that we were in love yesterday and I imagine it just broke Chika’s brain.
: That doesn’t make any sense. Why would Niki tell the world she’s in love with you?
: Probably because she is.
: Why, though? She can do so much better.
: So can your sister and that’s never stopped her from being obsessed with me.
: Good point, Papa. Chinami has a lot of questions but, right now, she cares most about teaching her big sister how to talk again. And nothing she’s tried has worked.
: Well, what have you tried?
: A bunch of stuff. But not even getting a bunch of peanuts delivered here and threatening to eat them in front of her could make her blink.
: Chinami had to drag her all the way over to the chair just so she wouldn’t be standing all night. She’s at her wit’s end here!
: And it turned out that all the peanuts did was lead to temptation and now Chinami is suffering too!
: I’m actually impressed you aren’t dead yet.
: Me too, but for other sadder reasons than just peanuts. Do you think you can fix her?
: Only one way to find out.
: Chika, I hereby exercise my power as your idol’s significant other to grant you exclusive behind-the-scenes access to Niki for whatever her next public event is.
: Assuming she actually has another and that she isn’t being sued for breach of contract.
: Fine. I also grant you exclusive behind-the-scenes access to Niki in her natural habitat — watching anime in my bedroom with a bag of potato chips in her lap.
: And I cannot overstate just how much of a risk I am taking by telling you this as the sheer idea of such a thing would ruin her image, so I’m told.
: Do you think it’s working?
: Chika, if you don’t say anything in the next ten seconds, I’m going to run away with your little sister and marry her.
: Chinami never consented to this! She doesn’t even know if she likes boys yet!
: I don’t think it matters.
: Of course it matters! Chinami doesn’t wanna marry somebody she doesn’t love! Especially not after being kidnapped!
: No, I mean it isn’t working. Chika’s catatonia has seemingly overwritten both her moral obligations and her most intense desires. I’m not sure I can help.
: What do you mean you can’t help?! Are you saying that big sis Chika is stuck like this forever?! Chinami’s not supposed to be the caregiver in this relationship! She is!
: At the very least, we should try and get that knife out of her hands. This isn’t exactly the type of situation sharp objects help with, I don’t think.
: Chinami tried already, but big sis Chika just held it up higher and Chinami couldn’t reach it.
: Okay. Well, that’s good at least. It seems she’s still subconsciously trying to protect you.
: And if the Chika we know is buried somewhere inside of the Chika shell we have here, we just need to figure out how to...unearth her.
: Unearth her? But how are we gonna do that?
: I do have one idea. It just requires a level of...participation I’m not sure I’m going to get.
: Participation?...
: Surely Papa doesn’t intend to make love to big sis Chika in her current state?!
: What? Where did...no. What?
: Okay...If Papa thinks that’s the only way to make her go back to normal, Chinami has no choice but to support it. She grants you consent on behalf of her big sister.
: I literally just said no.
: All she asks is that you be gentle with her to avoid breaking her more. Because she’s heard you guys together before and thinks you might be a little too rough sometimes.
: Chinami, are you even listening to me?
: No.
: But you just responded...
: Because I think it might be a good idea now! And it’s Papa’s fault for making me think that by saying “participation” so weirdly! What else was that supposed to mean in that context?!
: Certainly not taking advantage of a girl who’s basically in a vegetative state right now.
: Not even if it’s the only way to save her?!
: She’s holding a knife.
: So what?! Maybe Papa likes living on the edge and doesn’t have a problem with that?!
: Chinami, by “participation” I meant calling someone else to come and help.
: But who else besides Papa would be able to fix big sis Chika right now? Big sis Yumi maybe? To try and beat her up?
: Why are all of your ideas so physical all of a sudden?
: Chinami was desperate for food and ate a bunch of sugar packets before Papa came here. She thinks that may have made her crazy.
: You just wanted to eat sugar packets, didn’t you?
: I’ll do anything to save my sister. I don’t care how much sugar I need to eat to do it.
: That’s great, Chinami. But what I was thinking was getting Niki to come here to see if she can help.
: You can’t invite her here! Chinami doesn’t have anything to wear! She can’t meet a celebrity looking like this!
: You look really cute, though.
: Maybe to you! But not to a world famous idol that Chinami has posters of! Why do you even know her anyway?!
: We were childhood friends, Chinami. Her little sister is literally Chika’s classmate.
: Why were you childhood friends with somebody so much younger than you?! Has Papa always been a lolicon?!
: She’s only two years younger than me...
: Lies! Chinami will believe it once the celebrity is in her house! She just needs to find something to wear first!
: Are you really sure you don’t want to try the other idea first, though? Maybe Papa can shock big sis Chika back to life with his-
: Yeah, no. Stay here. I’m going to make a call.
: What do you mean “stay here?!” Where else do you expect Chinami to go?!
: I have no idea. Go eat some more sugar packets or something.
: Fine! But only because Chinami is feeling particularly obedient all of a sudden!
: Wow, I wonder why.
: Hello?
: Hi. I have a bit of an issue.
: You have many issues, Akira. Surely you don’t expect me to be able to help you with all of them?
: Not all of them. This one would be nice, though.
: I’m sorry. But I told you last night that I don’t want to have sex with you yet. I don’t care how desperately you miss my body.
: That’s not it. I promise.
: Well what is it then? Because I’m very busy throwing away all the things in your room that I don’t like right now and you are bothering me.
: So, do you remember all those times I used to call you to prove to people that we’re dating?
: Yes. Do you remember yesterday when I confirmed this to the entire world on social media, thus ensuring that such a thing would never have to happen again?
: See, that’s exactly the problem. Your post sent one of my ex-students into shock and now she’s no longer moving or speaking and her sister is binging on sugar.
: You told me I could!
: I see. And why do you know this, exactly?
: Because I’m at her apartment as we speak.
: Oh, good. That’s an excellent thing to hear less than twenty-four hours after talking me back into a relationship with you.
: You don’t get it. I’m only here because her little sister called me after failing to resolve things on her own.
: So what I’m hearing is that your number is in some little girl’s phone and you also know where she lives.
: Can you help me or not? Because I can promise you you’d much prefer this option than the other one floating around right now.
: Ugh. What do I have to do? Just come there and fucking...sign something? What do you want from me?
: I don’t think you need to sign anything. Just come...say hi or something. She’s one of your biggest fans, so I’m pretty sure your presence alone will shock her back into existence.
: Hah...fine. But only because I want to put her in her place and dissuade her from pursuing you any further than she already has, you pathetic, teen-fucking human dildo.
: Thank you, Niki. I’ll try and wrestle the knife out of her hand in the meantime.
: Wonderful. Just send me the address and-
: Wait, why is there a knife in her hand?! Just what the fuck are you getting me into?!
